scope: Proposed operator engineering tutorial packet and response importer; read-only ordinary development audit, not formal red team or study outcomes.
core_decisions: Use a new versioned operator/tutorial contract. Existing clinical_review intentionally exposes model-visible interaction and criteria only; source-context bundles expose authored source, engineering expectations, oracle output, model/attempt labels and host path provenance. Do not inherit blinded or clinical-adjudication wording.

Make source import a pure preflight step. Validate every selected case, protocol and assignment before creating any output. Never silently omit an invalid, unavailable or duplicate source from the planned denominator.

Read fixed copied payloads inside the selected case bundle. Manifest input_paths and source_files are historical provenance strings, not files to open, import or execute. The case bundle must remain portable when original paths are absent.

Require recognized bundle and source-context versions, complete status, exact supported payload inventory (the optional inputs/verification.json is allowed only with its corresponding declaration), and valid lowercase SHA256 file values. Check raw bytes before parsing, then strict finite/unique-key JSON objects. Do not treat status=complete as task or clinical success.

Reject unsupported manifest payload names, traversal/absolute aliases, duplicate canonical paths, missing/nonregular files, symlinks within the bundle and unlisted payloads. Resolve a user-selected root once and detect duplicate root aliases; never follow internal symlinks outside the snapshot. This is a bounded self-contained snapshot rule, not a general filesystem sandbox claim.

Compare all four canonical reconciliation bindings using ensure_ascii=False, exact JSON types and finite numbers. clinical_review._digest uses ensure_ascii=True and is not the source-binding function. Byte identity and canonical identity serve distinct roles and must have separately named fields.

Recompute the oracle and diagnostic from copied scenario/expectations/evidence using the supported known implementation; compare complete type-sensitive canonical objects with supplied verification.json and explanation.json. Matching hashes alone cannot establish faithful derivation. Preserve originals and stop on disagreement rather than repairing them silently.

Bind the actual rendered report bytes, but do not trust a self-rehashed arbitrary HTML file as faithful display. Prefer generating the new packet's display from validated JSON with a controlled recorded title/render mode. If original HTML is copied, retain it as captured material and validate its rendering under a known renderer/title contract before treating it as the authoritative display. Existing bundle manifests do not record title.

Record verifier/renderer versions and source hashes used by the new packet. Never execute source code named in an imported manifest. A later version disagreement is an explicit compatibility/derivation failure, not permission to overwrite original diagnostics or scores.

Assign unique packet, assignment, case and item IDs and validate uniqueness plus complete cross-links before constructing dictionaries. Existing per-case reconciliation evidence does not contain attempt_id/case_id/trial_id. A directory name is a label; explicit attempt metadata remains an operator assertion unless separately bound to a frozen execution roster.

Reject ambiguous duplicate bundle roots, copied source identities or repeated case/attempt IDs within a packet rather than silently changing the denominator. If a later repeated-measures protocol intentionally assigns the same evidence more than once, it needs an explicit versioned rule; multiple questions may already share one case without creating extra attempts.

Keep a complete assignment roster. Missing or exact blank response rows are pending; explicit abstentions/unavailable responses remain separate. No absence, blank time, or incomplete response becomes a zero, negative finding, success or completed participant.

Require response packet/assignment/reviewer bindings plus strict row schema, unique known item IDs, valid case links and evidence references restricted to that case's fixed source registry. Preserve raw submitted bytes. Identity and independence remain self-reported, not authenticated.

Use packet+assignment(+declared reviewer) as receipt identity, not a directory count. Exact resubmissions must not create additional reviewers; changed submissions for the same identity must be explicit revisions/conflicts, never silently pooled as independent observations.

Seal the coordinator packet, readable display, full case snapshots, protocol and assignment before distribution. Response import must recheck these exact captures without relying on original mutable source paths. New output paths are exclusive; a failed import must leave original artifacts untouched.

Keep current inputs explicitly tutorial-only. Imported structured responses establish format/binding consistency only. They do not establish an actual participant, measured time, usability improvement, clinical validity, blinding, clinical readiness or a benchmark result. Automated answer checks and operator outcomes must be separately labeled.

priority_independent_tests.case: Each actual v3 case imports as a distinct planned opportunity with all copied bytes unchanged.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Four cases retained; no clinical or participant claims; recomputed diagnostic/oracle equal supplied values.

priority_independent_tests.case: Tamper one byte in each of scenario, expectations, evidence, explanation, verification and report separately.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Preflight rejects before any packet output.

priority_independent_tests.case: Change exclusion diagnosis or observed event count and update its file hash while preserving source bindings.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Independent diagnostic recomputation rejects; matching file hashes are insufficient.

priority_independent_tests.case: Change the oracle and update its byte/canonical binding everywhere, preserving all original source inputs.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Full oracle recomputation rejects, with no rewritten original artifact.

priority_independent_tests.case: Append arbitrary display content to report.html and update only its manifest hash.
priority_independent_tests.expected: The importer does not present it as a faithful regenerated report; controlled render verification rejects or uses a separately labeled regenerated display.

priority_independent_tests.case: Use legitimate Unicode, null, false and zero in independently bound copied data; contrast false versus zero mutants.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Unicode canonicalization succeeds under reconciliation policy; type changes cannot hide behind Python equality.

priority_independent_tests.case: Duplicate JSON keys, NaN and exponent overflow in each import surface.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Strict parsing rejects without partial output.

priority_independent_tests.case: Missing manifest, incomplete status, wrong bundle kind, unsupported source-context version, missing mandatory payload or undeclared optional verification.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Explicit controlled rejection before writes; no guessed default completion.

priority_independent_tests.case: Missing, extra, absolute, traversal or canonically aliasing manifest file paths, dangling/internal/outside symlinks, and directory in place of a payload.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Reject the non-self-contained or ambiguous source before reading outside the bundle or writing packet output.

priority_independent_tests.case: Move a valid source bundle and remove access to all paths recorded in input_paths/source_files.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Import remains possible from verified local payloads; original paths are never opened.

priority_independent_tests.case: Supply one bundle twice, a root symlink alias, and a copied bundle under a new label.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Duplicate opportunity is rejected explicitly; no double count or silent deduplication.

priority_independent_tests.case: Supply duplicate/colliding case, attempt, item or assignment IDs in an otherwise self-consistent manifest; include a foreign item-to-case mapping.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Reject before dictionary construction; list rows cannot collapse into a smaller assigned denominator.

priority_independent_tests.case: A valid first case followed by malformed second case; a valid unavailable diagnostic under the declared selection policy.
priority_independent_tests.expected: No partial packet for invalid source; unavailable cases remain explicit or reject the whole declared cohort, never silently disappear.

priority_independent_tests.case: Render hostile source/title/response strings and reference a missing or malformed decoded-note location.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Static inert display and only internal links; missing values remain unavailable, not null. No browser validation claim.

priority_independent_tests.case: Import a wholly blank response, an omitted row, and explicit abstention separately.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Full assigned denominator retained; pending versus unassessed distinct; no synthetic times or outcomes.

priority_independent_tests.case: Response references wrong packet, assignment, reviewer, case or item; duplicate rows and unknown fields.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Controlled rejection before receipt output.

priority_independent_tests.case: Use a valid reference from a different assigned case; duplicate or malformed pointers.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Case-local evidence allowlist rejects cross-case citation and malformed references.

priority_independent_tests.case: Import the same response twice in separate directories, then a changed response with the same assignment identity.
priority_independent_tests.expected: No additional independent participant; explicit identical duplicate versus conflicting/revised submission accounting.

priority_independent_tests.case: Change coordinator packet JSON, readable report, protocol, assignment or one source snapshot after issuance.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Receipt import detects change even if original outside source paths are unavailable.

priority_independent_tests.case: Existing output, dangling output link and injected exclusive-save race winner.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Existing bytes survive; no overwrite or false completion receipt.

priority_independent_tests.case: Self-reported credentials, independent-review flag or submitted time claims are present and plausible.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Receipt still labels them unauthenticated/self-reported; tutorial outcomes never become clinical or measured-value evidence.

priority_independent_tests.case: Importer implementation/derivation version differs from the sealed packet or original source contract.
priority_independent_tests.expected: Explicit version/compatibility handling without silent rescoring or original artifact mutation.

evidence: audit.json and audit_inputs.py in the same directory; four actual immutable source bundles and eight offline boundary controls.
limitations: No production importer implemented or changed by this audit.
No model, provider, daemon, network, browser or real participant activity.
Existing clinical_review boundary demonstrations use synthetic temporary artifacts and do not claim general security exploitability or authenticated authorship.
The above tests are recommendations for the new implementation, not tests already passed by a nonexistent operator importer.
